name: ACT-462206
summary: ACT-462206 is a dual orexin receptor antagonist (IC50 for OX1 = 60nM, OX2 = 11nM) which has been investigated for the treatment of insomnia. In human trials, ACT-462206 produced dose-dependent sedative effects and was generally well tolerated, with residual sleepiness and headache being the most common adverse events.

pharmacology.text: ACT-462206 is a dual orexin receptor antagonist (IC50 for OX1 = 60nM, OX2 = 11nM) which has been investigated for the treatment of insomnia.

uses.text: ACT-462206 is a dual orexin receptor antagonist (IC50 for OX1 = 60nM, OX2 = 11nM) which has been investigated for the treatment of insomnia.

sideEffects.en: In human trials the most common effects were sleepiness lasting into the next day and headache.
sideEffects.zh: 在人體試驗中，最常見的反應是嗜睡延續到隔天，以及頭痛。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在人体试验中，最常见的反应是嗜睡延续到隔天，以及头痛。

fact.en: It blocks the orexin receptors. Orexin was discovered in 1998, and people with narcolepsy largely lack the brain cells that make it, which is why blocking it brings on sleep.
fact.zh: 它會阻斷食慾素（orexin）受體。食慾素於1998年被發現，而嗜睡症患者大多缺少製造它的腦細胞；這也是阻斷它會讓人入睡的原因。
fact.zhHans: 它会阻断食欲素（orexin）受体。食欲素于1998年被发现，而嗜睡症患者大多缺少制造它的脑细胞；这也是阻断它会让人入睡的原因。
